images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: a square 1:1 illustration for an action card named CIBLE in a neo-retro video game. No text or full card frame.
Concept: AIM / TARGET as a SUBMARINE PERISCOPE, a tangible optical instrument. We see straight through a large circular periscope eyepiece, with an unmistakable coarse YELLOW crosshair and three stepped concentric range rings centered on a small red floating marker in a flat blue sea. A chunky dark navy and cobalt metal eyepiece rim surrounds the view, with two or three big blocky bolts and a simple corner knob. The central crosshair is the subject and instantly recognizable at thumbnail size. Sea/horizon sparse and secondary. NO animal, NO monster, NO lizard, NO organism, NO creature, NO person, NO cute mascot, NO ship, no narrative scene.
Style: DELIBERATELY DRAWN pixel art, coarse 96x96 logical pixel clusters enlarged cleanly. Inspired by home-computer adventure graphics and 2015 indie games, economical exact chunky steps, only about 10 flat colors. Main palette almost black #081322, navy, cobalt, pale cyan; bright yellow crosshair, tiny red accent. Large solid areas, no dither carpet, no noisy surface texture. Entire picture readable as a single strong instrument rather than a control dashboard. No photorealism, smooth rendering, lighting gradients, blur, antialiasing, 3D, lettering, numerals, labels, watermark, decorative border.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: square 1:1 illustration for a neo-retro action card named CIBLE. Conceptual representation level 4: a HUMAN ARCHER aiming at an ARCHERY TARGET.
One rugged adult human archer with a modest green Robin Hood hat, blue tunic and red neck scarf at LEFT, in a natural three-quarter side stance, holding a simple wooden bow and drawing a single arrow aimed at the bullseye of a LARGE yellow-and-red round archery target on the RIGHT. Bow and arrow clearly legible. Show archer waist up, bow fully visible, target occupies about one third of the picture. Strong directional silhouette from bow to bullseye. No animals anywhere, NO lizard, NO dragon, NO monster, NO little creature, no mascot, no crowd. Plain near-black/navy clearing with only two blue block silhouettes to establish depth, no busy forest scenery. The illustration must instantly read 'AIM AT A TARGET' even at small size. The human is an illustrative metaphor, not a new main game character.
Style: hand-designed 8-bit/early-16-bit pixel illustration, enlarged 96x96 logical pixel grid, bold flat chunky pixel clusters, clear stepped outlines, about 12 flat colors, deep black and BLUE dominant with a few green, red and yellow accents. Expressive but restrained hand-authored game art. Large shapes, two skin tones, simple face. No photographic processing, no smooth curves, no gradients, no painterly detail, no dither carpet, no 3D. No text, numerals, watermark or full card frame.

scope: Art and typography review only. No game rule changes or cost model. Native slider is a placement sketch.

board.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / art-direction comparison.
Create a wide landscape presentation board showing EXACTLY FOUR COMPLETE neo-retro game cards side by side, equal size, same simple dark navy physical card frame. This is an evolution game with POINTS, NOT animals. We are comparing four different levels of conceptual representation of the action TARGET. No animals, lizards, monsters, organisms, cute creatures or mascots ANYWHERE. No logos of existing games.
Two reference images: image1 is the visual reference for card THREE's periscope picture. image2 is the visual reference for card FOUR's archer picture. Keep their fundamental concepts, no extra imagery.
Layout: very dark blue background, four portrait cards in ONE row, generous gutters. Each card approx 2:3 ratio, full card visible uncropped. Black/navy and blue palette, small yellow/red accents. Straight thin pixel-stepped borders, no gilded fantasy ornaments, no app dashboard. Each card's illustration is a large SQUARE occupying its upper two thirds. Under it, ONE title and ONE concise effect sentence. At bottom one small horizontal unlabelled slider with a square yellow thumb. No costs, numbers, percentages, badges, rarity, stats, extra text or paragraphs.
Card1, small outside label "SIGNE": extremely minimal flat PIXEL SYMBOL, a single large yellow circle with crosshair lines and red dot at center on blank navy background. Just that powerful geometric aim symbol; broad chunky pixel steps, 3 colors, absolutely no scene or object.
Card2, small outside label "POINTS": a literal sparse GAME DIAGRAM, one tiny living cyan point in lower left, a dashed cyan arrow toward a yellow crosshair target in upper right, 4 other tiny dim blue points on a very faint blue square grid. No animal. Visually a plan view of the simulation, abstract yet clearly relational.
Card3, small outside label "PÉRISCOPE": the large circular submarine periscope eyepiece from reference1, yellow crosshair and range rings centered on a tiny red sea marker. A tangible blue metal optical instrument, coarse pixel-art scene.
Card4, small outside label "ARCHER": the rugged HUMAN Robin-Hood-like archer from reference2, blue tunic, green cap, drawing a bow toward a large yellow/red archery target. Coarse hand-drawn pixel art. A narrative character metaphor, not an animal.
Text EXACTLY repeated on all four cards below each picture:
Title: "CIBLE"
Effect: "Accélère vers sa cible."
Use a clear compact industrial game font, no decorative letterspacing, no serif and no Courier. All four cards have THE SAME typography and frame, so the illustration approach alone is compared. Correct French accents and period, no other card prose. Good legibility, no text clipping. The symbol, diagram, instrument, human scene must be UNMISTAKABLY FOUR DIFFERENT visual languages, from maximum synthesis to characterization. No photo texture, no blurry gradients, no realistic 3D.
